concept.text: Incidence of adverse events Incidence and severity of adverse events and serious adverse events as graded by National Cancer Institute Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events version 5.0. Includes significant changes in laboratory parameters, electrocardiograms, and vital signs. Summarized by grade and type.
